pages.text: $(bold)Energy Generation Upgrade$(): install into the upgrade slots of the $(bold)Chishi Generator$() (single), $(bold)Assembly$() or $(bold)Super Architecture$() GUI to boost output.$(br)$(li)Each boosts output speed x1.75$(li)Each reduces yield by 1%$(li)Up to 10 installed, one per slot

$(bold)Multiplier (n items = 1.75^n x (1 - 1% x n)):$(br)$(li)1: x1.73$(li)2: x3.00$(li)3: x5.20$(li)5: x15.6$(li)10: x241.6$(br)$(bold)Note:$() A single generator makes 75 E/t; with 10 upgrades it reaches ~18k E/t. The multiblock upgrade slots live in the core GUI; shell slots proxy to the core when formed.
